subject: Billing coordination for Stellar EU — VAT certificate + direct debit / tax form
messages:
From: Marco van Dijk <m.vandijk@stellarsystems.eu>
To: jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Eve Tanner <eve.tanner@stellarsystems.io>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 15:15:00 +0100
Subject: Billing options for Stellar EU (VAT handling + payment method)

Hi Jasmine,

Quick note from the finance team here — Stellar Systems (parent in US, EU subsidiary 'Stellar EU B.V.') is onboarding with Redwood and we have two questions before we finalise payment:

1) Tax forms: our legal team says the EU entity is a Dutch company and will want to provide a W-8BEN-E. Will Redwood accept the W-8 for the EU entity rather than providing a W-9 from the US parent? We want to make sure invoices are issued to the right legal entity to avoid VAT mismatch.

2) Payment method: Our bank prefers SEPA direct debit to wires for smaller recurring charges. Can Redwood accept SEPA direct debit mandates, or do we need to set up wired ACH each month?

Attached is a draft invoice for the first month and the bank's sample SEPA mandate template for your finance team to check.

Thanks — Marco
Marco van Dijk
Finance Manager, Stellar EU B.V.
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marco van Dijk <m.vandijk@stellarsystems.eu>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Billing options for Stellar EU (VAT handling + payment method)

Hi Marco — thanks for the clear note and the attachments. Quick answers and next steps below.

Short answers:
- Yes, Redwood can invoice and collect from the EU legal entity (Stellar EU B.V.) if you provide the entity's proof of incorporation plus a signed W-8BEN-E (since the contracting entity is a foreign company). You do not need to provide the US parent's W-9 if the payee is the EU company.
- We support SEPA direct debit for EU customers, but it requires a completed Redwood Direct Debit Mandate and a signed bank confirmation for the account you want debited.

What we need from you to proceed (please upload these to the DocuSign link or return as PDFs):
1) Signed W-8BEN-E for Stellar EU B.V. — ensure the legal name on line 1 matches your company registration.
2) Copy of the Dutch VAT registration certificate (for reverse-charge / VAT handling on our invoices).
3) Proof of incorporation (extract from the Dutch Chamber of Commerce).
4) Completed SEPA mandate (we will provide the Redwood template; your bank's template is OK but we prefer our mandate) — bank name + IBAN + BIC + authorised signatory signature.

Laura (cc) is our finance lead and will share the Redwood mandate and a short checklist. Once we receive the docs we can: confirm whether invoices will be net of VAT (reverse charge) and enable SEPA debit for recurring payments.

Let me know if the account is single-entity billing or if you want the parent to be billed — that will change tax form requirements.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marco van Dijk <m.vandijk@stellarsystems.eu>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Redwood finance checklist + SEPA mandate (doc)

Hi Marco — looping in formal instructions from Redwood Finance. Thanks for sending the draft invoice. Attached are: Redwood_DirectDebit_Mandate.pdf (our preferred SEPA mandate), and a short Tax_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx.

Please note the following points when filling the mandate:
- Beneficiary name on the mandate must be "Stellar EU B.V." and must match your Chamber of Commerce extract exactly.
- If the IBAN is in a corporate account but the signatory is a delegated signatory, please include a brief authorisation letter from the board or attach a signatory list from the bank.
- For tax form acceptance: a completed and signed W-8BEN-E is sufficient for us to treat the payee as a foreign entity for US 1099 purposes. Redwood will NOT issue a 1099 to a foreign legal entity. If at any point the US parent is the billed entity, we will require a W-9 and 1099 reporting may apply.

DocuSign link for mandates & forms: https://app.docusign.com/confirm/abc123-direct-debit (expires in 10 days)

Attachments in this thread:
- Redwood_DirectDebit_Mandate.pdf (pdf, 1 page)
- Tax_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx (xlsx)

If you prefer to return signed PDFs by email, that works too. Once completed we will enable SEPA debits and set the invoice VAT handling to reverse-charge where your VAT certificate proves intra-EU B2B supply.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marco van Dijk <m.vandijk@stellarsystems.eu>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Eve Tanner <eve.tanner@stellarsystems.io>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 16:02:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Billing options for Stellar EU (VAT handling + payment method)

Hi Jasmine / Laura — thanks for the clear checklist. We completed the steps on our side: attached are the signed W-8BEN-E (scanned), the Dutch VAT registration certificate, and our Chamber of Commerce extract. We also signed your Redwood SEPA mandate via DocuSign (link confirms completion).

Two quick clarifications from our legal team before you flip the switch:
1) 1099 exposure: Because the ultimate parent is a US entity, will Redwood ever ask for the US EIN or require a W-9 if we are invoiced under the EU subsidiary's name? We recorded your line that a foreign payee will not receive a 1099, but want confirmation in writing for our auditors.
2) Refund/credit flows: if a credit is issued (e.g., pro rata for cancellation), will Redwood refund to the SEPA-debited account or to whichever payment method was active at the time? We prefer refunds to the SEPA account.

Attachments: Signed_W-8BEN-E_StellarEU.pdf (pdf), Stellar_VAT_certificate_BV.pdf (pdf)

If all looks good on your side we will consider the account fully onboarded and expect the first SEPA debit to occur on the next invoice date.

Best regards,
Marco van Dijk
Finance Manager, Stellar EU B.V.

On a related note, Eve (cc) — can you confirm to your treasury team that the DocuSign mandate has been completed?
